decision_source: Accepted analysis-window v5 execution handoff and documented before/after decision.

lineage_boundary.implementation_method: immutable reporting-window record and additive v5 analysis views expose effective eligibility without mutating historical source, processing, curated, or release evidence

injury_rule.dated_eligibility: A dated included injury is v5-eligible only when its injury date is within the inclusive reporting window and all existing cohort rules are satisfied.
injury_rule.dated_pre_window_status: Valid cleaned injury, excluded only from the v5 reporting cohort; it is not a master or inclusion exclusion.
injury_rule.undated_season_attributed: Retain in applicable totals and non-monthly breakdowns; exclude from monthly series.
injury_rule.monthly_binding: Every v5 monthly reader must bind to analysis_window_2024-25_2026-07-25_v1. Monthly time-loss totals must equal dated time-loss totals from that same v5 cohort.
injury_rule.authoritative_lineage: The 3,060-row master, ordered decision ledger, and accepted 2,301-row inclusion CSV remain unchanged.

exposure_rule.readmit_condition: Remove outside_official_analysis_window only when it is the sole historical reason preventing inclusion and the effective reporting period overlaps the inclusive v5 reporting window.
exposure_rule.other_exclusions: Retain every other historical exclusion, including rehabilitation, return-to-play, international, other-team, academy, validity, and quality exclusions.
exposure_rule.weekly_period_rule: A weekly row covers its recorded start date through the following six calendar days. It remains weekly and is never converted to sessions.

pre_urc_match_scope.rule: Exclude only clearly evidenced match, friendly, opponent-fixture, or equivalent non-URC match activity in the newly opened pre-URC band.
pre_urc_match_scope.semantic_interpretation: Apply equivalent context deterministically, not one exact regular expression. Retain ambiguous labels, warm-ups, top-ups, captain's runs, Game -N training-cycle labels, and blank labels unless other evidence clearly identifies a non-URC match.
pre_urc_match_scope.verified_required_cases: The two verified Sharks Currie Cup match sessions dated 2024-09-08 and 2024-09-14 are excluded.
pre_urc_match_scope.scope_limit: Do not generalise this pre-URC rule to existing-window rows, the rest of the season, or a league-wide URC-opponent rule.

evidence_artifact_locators.row_identifier_policy: Each row-level artefact uses a deterministic evidence key derived from the stable source-row identifier rather than a direct identifier or protected metadata.
